defensives.name: Anti-Magic Shell
defensives.usage_rule: Press before incoming magic damage to absorb it and generate Runic Power; use it proactively on telegraphed magic hits since the shield only lasts 5 seconds.

defensives.name: Icebound Fortitude
defensives.usage_rule: Use for heavy physical hits or tankbusters to reduce all damage taken and gain stun immunity for the duration.

defensives.name: Lichborne
defensives.usage_rule: Activate to become immune to Charm, Fear, and Sleep effects, and to enable Death Coil self-healing during dangerous windows.

defensives.name: Death Strike
defensives.usage_rule: Spend Runic Power on it as an on-demand self-heal when you dip low; its heal scales with recent damage taken so press it after a hit rather than before.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Zone
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it for the group ahead of a raid-wide magic burst to reduce magic damage taken for everyone standing inside (talent choice in some builds).
